title: Locally perfect constant scalar models
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $S$ a scheme in the small pro-etale setting [sk-def-pe-site]. Use the ordinary unbounded module derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] over $\Lambda_S$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Write $R=\Lambda(*)$ and use its constant-sheaf scalar extension [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. A complex $P$ is locally perfect over the scalar ring if there is a pro-etale cover $\{W_j\to S\}$ such that for every $j$ there is a bounded cochain complex $C_j$ of finite projective $R$-modules with $P|_{W_j}\simeq Q(\Lambda_{W_j}\otimes_R C_j)$ in the derived category, where $P|_{W_j}$ is the termwise module inverse image along $W_j\to S$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Bounds and complexes may depend on $j$. Finite projective means finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], equivalently a retract of a finite free scalar module [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module]; these are perfect scalar-ring complexes [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. The termwise scalar-extension construction is the existing one of [lem-sfb-perfect-scalar-change-model].
